tagline: Pure Coriander Essence for Food Formulations
overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium spray dried coriander powder from India. Our advanced spray-drying technology preserves aromatic volatile oils and natural color. The resulting free-flowing powder provides uniform particle size and reliable solubility. Formulated for industrial processing, it prevents clumping and integrates smoothly into automated dosing systems for high-volume manufacturing lines.

We support global food brands through bulk supply and OEM private label solutions. Operating via a rigorous six-step process from seed sourcing to dispatch, we maintain strict moisture and particle control across batches. We offer export documentation support and customizable packaging options. Every batch delivers shelf-stable aromatic intensity, ensuring reliable performance in seasoning mixes, prepared meals, and commercial culinary applications.
highlights: Fine mesh size of 80 to 100 mesh for rapid dissolution
Low moisture content under 5 percent prevents clumping
Free-flowing consistency suited for automated dosing lines
Encapsulated volatile oils ensure long-lasting natural aroma
Extended shelf life of 18 to 24 months
Manufactured in India under controlled spray-drying conditions
applications: Meat marinades and processed meat products
Dehydrated meal kits and culinary bases
packaging: Custom private label pouches and jars

faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 Kg, accommodating pilot runs as well as bulk commercial orders.

faqs.a: Yes, we provide OEM and contract packaging into small retail pouches, jars, or custom bulk sizes.

faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request for quality evaluation and formulation trials.

faqs.a: The shelf life is 18 to 24 months when stored in a cool, dry place away from sunlight and moisture.

faqs.a: Yes, we accommodate custom mesh sizing and tailored packaging formats based on your processing needs.

faqs.a: Yes, as an IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete export documentation support for global orders.
